selection: For each fixed case choose smaller retained arrival in repeat1. Invalid or non-improving candidates retain baseline. Ties choose direct.
evaluation: Evaluate selected strategy on repeat2 and repeat3; compare mean normalized retained gain, valid improvements and known tokens with always-direct and always-STA on the same case/repeat pairs.
scope: Exploratory offline routing analysis for these exact source, parameter and library contexts.
uncertainty: One training response per strategy per case, two held-out responses per strategy per case; three circuit families; descriptive results.
